doc: The accepted schedule of the synthetic invoice application's billing job (FIX-ASYNC-1): every day at 09:00 in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, the job selects the open invoices marked for a reminder and records one reminder request per invoice, in one transaction with its outbox message.
occurrenceId: billing-daily:<scheduledFor as ISO 8601 with the zone's offset>
effect: one reminder record and one sink notification per business key, within deadlineMs of the occurrence being due
